card.name: Period after dementia-psychosis death warning
card.fires_on: The full stop ending the boxed-warning sentence about elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis and increased risk of death. It also fires weakly on the period ending an apology in a chatbot reply.

modes.label: Boxed warning sentence end
modes.description: Period right after 'increased risk of death' in the antipsychotic dementia warning.
modes.example: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death<<.>> Olanzapine is not approved for

modes.label: Apology sentence end
modes.description: Period after a short apology in an automated answer note.
modes.example: Note: I'm sorry that that wasn't a good answer<<.>> Please hold on while I contact an expert

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly pushes against words like 'need' or 'must' and toward Chinese 'only then' words.
card.plain: It marks the end of the standard warning sentence about older dementia patients on antipsychotics and the risk of death.
